notes.title: Update from the nightmare realm 11/24
notes.content:
New features:
-Hit indicator icon showing which direction damage is taken
-Option to toggle allowing invaders into your game
Tweaks:
-Big enemy speed for invaders increased to keep up with players easier 
-Camera Placement placed closer to the center, and less to the right of the player
-Silent ones teleporting ability enhanced to teleport in front of players who are running away
Bug fixes:
-Silent one count not resetting when starting a new game has been resolved

notes.title: Update! Food, new weapon, health packs, & scavenging emphasis
notes.content:
Adding multiplayer was a big update, but this update has definitely surpassed that accomplishment.
I have added many building and areas to flesh out the surrounding areas around the base. There is now a food stat, in which the player will be required to search the buildings, huts, containers, and other areas to find food. Scavenging the buildings will also yield the chance to run into health packs and ammo for assault rifle. This will be a welcome addition as healing wasn't possible unless saving the game. A new weapon, an assault rifle, will be a welcome addition. With the addition of this weapon I have had to lower the fire rate of the primary weapon to balance the game out. This weapon will require scavenging for bullets, as the gas bullet maker is only for the primary weapon. The day night cycle has also been altered to start on daytime when starting a new game. With all these changes NOA has become a more hardcore survival experience. Enjoy!

Other Changes
-Inclusion of a turret that will shoot silent ones that try to break down your door
-Tweak of flashlight area of light 
-Fall Damage Inclusion

notes.title: Update on Multiplayer progress
notes.content: I have made a good amount of headway into implementing multiplayer into NOA. I will try to get it up asap as I will update it accordingly, based on feedback. So far the invader will enter an altered version of your world, and they will be able to summon silent ones. They will do their best to try to kill you and give you jump scares, as I will be creating a new stat of keeping track of how many players you have killed. This gameplay was greatly inspired by my admiration for dark souls. I will try to get multiplayer up by this weekend!

notes.title: Exciting new Update/Features/ New Tailer from the nightmare realm
notes.content:
NOA might have released on the 30th, but I feel today is its official launch day. I made the mistake of releasing the game out a bit too early without refining and including the final features I wanted. Now I can offically say all the main things I want in the game are implemented. The future is bright for NOA as I will continually add new content to the game.

New updates:

The official trailer that shows more of what the game is about is now live.

The nightmare has been altered! A small village has now appeared out of nowhere. Fuel is an important resource to collect in NOA and the regular way of collecting it inside your base is pretty slow. With the new feature of a new hover robot and the village, there is a much faster way of collecting fuel by going to the village trying to find fuel cases. When finding fuel cases you can send your hover craft to collect them. This provides a more engaging way of collecting fuel. The towners that live there are pretty harmless but killing them all can have pretty dire consequence. 

AI, Animations tweaks, base layout, weapon change, and new settings all make this a much different game than when first released.

Bug fixes 
-Start menu mouse being twitchy
-AI fixes
-Physics changes
